customer_journey: ALERT -> BACKGROUND DELIVERY -> TAP -> OPPORTUNITY -> RETURN
observed_result: Current native client polls `/alerts` while the app logic is executing and schedules a local notification.
No remote push token registration contract was found.
No notification-response listener/deep-link contract was found to route a tapped notification to its opportunity.
Therefore a closed/background app receiving a new server-side opportunity alert cannot currently be classified READY_FOR_DEVICE for real push acceptance.
expected_truth: A real push-capable implementation must bind a device token to the authenticated tenant without client-supplied tenant authority.
Background delivery must preserve event identity and opportunity identity without cross-tenant leakage.
Tapping a notification must navigate to the exact current opportunity or fail honestly if it is no longer available/actionable.
Delivery acknowledgement must not be recorded merely because a server event existed; it must reflect the defined delivery contract.
required_retest: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: device-token registration and tenant authority contract.
PROVEN_AUTOMATED: notification response routes by event/opportunity identity and respects current lifecycle truth.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE: tap -> exact opportunity -> return to refreshed Radar.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE: wrong-tenant token/event cannot surface private alert data.
hard_boundary: Golden Path defines and executes acceptance only; notification implementation remains with its specialist owner.
